sentences.text_target: January is a cold winter month.
Today the weather is snowy.
I look outside the window.
The landscape is completely white.
It is a very cold morning.
I need to wear warm clothes.
I put on my heavy jacket.
I take my red scarf.
I wear thick gloves on my hands.
sentences.phonetic: /aɪ wɛr θɪk glʌvz ɑn maɪ hændz/

sentences.text_target: I open the front door.
I step outside into the snow.
The sky is full of grey clouds.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə skaɪ ɪz fʊl ʌv greɪ klaʊdz/

sentences.text_target: Suddenly, a small rain drop falls.
The weather changes from snowy to rainy.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə ˈwɛðər ˈtʃeɪndʒɪz frʌm ˈsnoʊi tuː ˈreɪni/

sentences.text_target: Water is now on the ground.
I walk slowly to the local park.
sentences.phonetic: /aɪ wɔk ˈsloʊli tuː ðə ˈloʊkəl pɑrk/

sentences.text_target: The trees have no green leaves.
Their branches are bare and brown.
No birds fly in the cold air.
sentences.phonetic: /noʊ bɜrdz flaɪ ɪn ðə koʊld ɛr/

sentences.text_target: It is windy near the big lake.
sentences.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ˈwɪndi nɪr ðə bɪg leɪk/

sentences.text_target: My face feels very cold.
I decide to go back home.
Tomorrow the season will still be winter.
sentences.phonetic: /təˈmɑroʊ ðə ˈsizən wɪl stɪl bi ˈwɪntər/

sentences.text_target: The afternoon brings a sunny break.
Golden light shines on the snow.
Soon the evening arrives quickly.
The temperature drops very low again.
I drink a hot cup of tea inside.
sentences.phonetic: /aɪ drɪŋk ə hɑt kʌp ʌv ti ɪnˈsaɪd/

sentences.text_target: My day ends quietly at home.
Now I go to sleep in my bed.
sentences.phonetic: /naʊ aɪ goʊ tuː sliːp ɪn maɪ bɛd/
